Name: AmIBeingPwned
Author: Bay Area Labs Inc - support@amibeingpwned.com
Description:
The [Am I Being Pwned](https://amibeingpwned.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests browser extension security events from Am I Being Pwned: issue alerts about risky extensions, detections of malicious extensions across the fleet, and removals of the Am I Being Pwned browser agent from devices. Analytic rules turn urgent alerts, widespread malicious extensions and agent removals into incidents, and a workbook summarizes alerts, top extensions and agent removals.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://aka.ms/Sentinel-CCP_Platform)
WorkbookDescription: Alerts over time by tier, the extensions with the most alerts and recent browser agent removals from Am I Being Pwned.
Analytic Rules: Analytic Rules/AIBP - Browser agent removed from device.yaml
Analytic Rules/AIBP - Malicious extension detected on many devices.yaml
Hunting Queries: Hunting Queries/AIBP - Extensions that steal logins or run remote code.yaml
Hunting Queries/AIBP - Browser agent removed soon after enrollment.yaml
Hunting Queries/AIBP - Extension spreading across users.yaml
Hunting Queries/AIBP - Browser agent removed after an alert.yaml
